source_sentence: Three-dimensional (3D) spatial perception from Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) point clouds provides essential sensory grounding for safe autonomous navigation, mobile robotics, and intelligent transportation systems.
note: Bản viết lại và lý do chi tiết nằm trong rewrites.md.

source_sentence: Unlike passive optical cameras, which remain vulnerable to ambient illumination fluctuations and projective scale ambiguities, LiDAR sensors actively emit pulsed laser beams to measure direct metric ranges, capturing high-precision geometric boundaries under arbitrary day-and-night conditions~\cite{geiger2012kitti}.
note: Bản viết lại và lý do chi tiết nằm trong rewrites.md.

source_sentence: In time-critical vehicular environments, perception systems must accurately detect, orient, and classify surrounding objects (from passenger vehicles to compact vulnerable road users such as pedestrians and cyclists) within strict latency envelopes, typically requiring sub-$100\,\text{ms}$ execution per scan~\cite{yang2018pixor}.
note: Bản viết lại và lý do chi tiết nằm trong rewrites.md.

source_sentence: However, deploying high-accuracy 3D object detection models on embedded vehicular platforms faces an acute operational tension between detection accuracy and hardware resource consumption.
note: Bản viết lại và lý do chi tiết nằm trong rewrites.md.

source_sentence: Consequently, developing ultra-compact yet highly discriminative LiDAR object detection architectures that sustain real-time execution without forfeiting spatial localization fidelity remains an essential prerequisite for scalable autonomous driving.
note: Bản viết lại và lý do chi tiết nằm trong rewrites.md.

source_sentence: First, volumetric voxel-based architectures, exemplified by SECOND~\cite{yan2018second}, and two-stage point-voxel frameworks, such as PointRCNN~\cite{shi2019pointrcnn}, Part-$A^2$~\cite{shi2020part}, and PV-RCNN~\cite{shi2020pvrcnn}, achieve competitive detection accuracy by deploying 3D sparse convolutions or localized point-cloud abstractions.
note: Bản viết lại và lý do chi tiết nằm trong rewrites.md.

source_sentence: While faster than volumetric methods, non-deterministic point gathering, dynamic memory allocation, and sparse scattering introduce substantial runtime overhead and memory transfer latency.
note: Bản viết lại và lý do chi tiết nằm trong rewrites.md.

source_sentence: Third, proposal-free BEV rasterization methods, such as PIXOR~\cite{yang2018pixor} and MobilePIXOR~\cite{nguyen2024indoor}, eliminate learned encoders entirely by discretizing point clouds into fixed vertical occupancy grids.
note: Bản viết lại và lý do chi tiết nằm trong rewrites.md.

source_sentence: Although conceptually efficient, existing rasterization methods suffer from severe spatial quantization errors on standard $0.1\,\text{m}$ grids; by relying on crude binary occupancy slices, they discard continuous subcell offsets and high-order vertical dispersion statistics, inducing spatial staircasing and localization jitter on small objects.
note: Bản viết lại và lý do chi tiết nằm trong rewrites.md.

source_sentence: The failure of existing compact detectors to simultaneously resolve fine subcell quantization errors, unphysical augmentation artifacts, multi-scale receptive field coverage, and geometric score misalignment constitutes the core bottleneck impeding sub-million-parameter LiDAR perception.
note: Bản viết lại và lý do chi tiết nằm trong rewrites.md.

source_sentence: We address this fundamental challenge through a key scientific insight: sub-voxel geometric precision can be preserved deterministically at the representation level by coupling multi-band vertical densities and continuous elevation moments with horizontal subcell centroid displacements, bypassing learned PointNet encoders entirely without forfeiting fine spatial boundaries.
note: Bản viết lại và lý do chi tiết nằm trong rewrites.md.

source_sentence: Grounded in this principle, we investigate the central research question: \textit{Can an ultra-compact LiDAR detector operating on a parameter-free BEV tensor rival the localization accuracy of heavy volumetric and pillar architectures while achieving superior end-to-end throughput on commodity edge hardware?}

source_sentence: To realize this objective, our framework couples this deterministic representation with a single-branch ConvNeXt-style backbone~\cite{liu2022convnext} utilizing large $7 \times 7$ depthwise kernels and parameter-free 3D spatial-energy attention (SimAM)~\cite{yang2021simam}, expanding physical receptive fields to envelop entire vehicles without multi-branch training overhead.

source_sentence: Together, these complementary mechanisms demonstrate that disciplined geometric encoding and calibrated multi-task loss formulation bridge the performance divide between compact 2D representations and multi-million-parameter 3D networks.

source_sentence: Guided by this design philosophy, we propose \textbf{MobilePIXORNeXt}, an ultra-compact, proposal-free, multi-class 3D LiDAR object detector containing exactly $753{,}569$ trainable parameters ($<0.76\,\text{M}$).
